coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured AI blog redirects to Microsoft Source AI. Thirteen topic-page title links were saved, mostly without list dates, and the configured RSS feed returned HTTP 410. A separate Source AI topic feed returned 10 entries, spanning June 2 through September 10, outside the discovery window. This alternative feed cannot replace the configured entry point. The follow-up did not fully pair list items with publication dates, so it does not establish that Microsoft had no updates.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The configured GitHub blog remains an old entry point, with its latest visible date September 23, 2025. Static research data, retrieval API attempts, and rendered views did not provide a complete, reliably paired current list. The final loaded research index showed September 20 Qwen-Image-2.1 and September 18 LiveTranslate and Omni-Flash entries, but pairing every item with its original URL remained incomplete. An absence of updates on the old blog does not establish coverage of the current research entry point.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The official Tongyi page yielded six news links without paired titles and publication dates, plus seven Qwen research links. Product and news entry points were checked again, but news dates remained incompletely paired. Links overlapping with Qwen retain their discovery channels and are not counted as separate news. These gaps do not establish an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: API updates, official English and Chinese news, the Harness page, and GitHub activity were recorded separately. The latest API date string was September 10; news and Harness dates reached September 29. The discovery window included 15 Harness commits and one release, but ordinary commits were not treated as model announcements. The full API changelog was not read, and its updates cannot establish complete coverage of research and model entry points.
coverage_gaps.智谱 Z.ai: After access failures, the official news list and model navigation were checked. Visible news dates ended at March 31; model navigation timestamps were not treated as news dates. The research entry point was not fully covered. The follow-up showed current model names, including GLM5.3, without absolute publication dates. Homepage access and product names do not establish complete window coverage.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The rendered official site and Step 5 Preview and StepAudio 3 entry points were inspected. Visible products also included Step 3.7 Flash and Step 3.5 Flash, but verifiable absolute publication dates were missing. An open-source countdown or a planned release date was not treated as an already completed release.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: Three homepage announcements and their dates were inspected, but new papers across the individual venues were not exhaustively traversed. Active venues and open-submission links lacked submission timestamps in the homepage record. Homepage access does not establish that the whole platform had no new submissions.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review: The topic feed returned 10 entries, spanning September 28 through October 5 at 15:47:52 UTC, including four in the discovery window. The follow-up browser check showed 10 topic-page titles, but publication dates and subsequent dynamic-list items were not fully paired. The feed does not replace complete inspection of the configured topic page; full-text reading is distinct from collection coverage.
